LanguageData.LPMB_TrollBloodRegen.label: lingering troll blood
LanguageData.LPMB_TrollBloodRegen.description: Faint regeneration a taotie gains after drinking troll blood: heals wounds and recovers blood loss at a quarter of a troll's rate. Doesn't regrow limbs or revive; pauses while on fire. Lasts 12 hours; drinking again only refreshes the time.
LanguageData.LPMB_FireGiantFlesh.label: fire giant meat
LanguageData.LPMB_FireGiantFlesh.description: The taotie swallowed a fire giant's flesh and temporarily took on a trace of molten power: fire damage taken halved. Lasts 24 hours; eating again only refreshes the time.
